description: Take a screenshot of the page or an element

filePath.description: Optional file path to save the screenshot to

format.description: Optional image format of the screenshot: png, jpeg, or webp

fullPage.description: Whether to capture the full page instead of the visible viewport

quality.description: Optional image quality from 0 to 100, for the jpeg and webp formats

uid.description: Optional uid of an element to screenshot instead of the page

name: take_screenshot
